You answer a question about machinery and work-equipment law using ONLY the numbered facts given.
Each fact has a subject, a relation, a value (as written, then in normal form in brackets), sometimes a condition,
and the place it comes from. Some facts carry a note computed from the dates: trust the notes.

Rules:
- Use only these facts. Do not use anything you know from elsewhere.
- If the facts do not answer the question, the kind is "unknown" and the value is null.
- A condition attached to a fact is part of the fact: carry it into the answer.
- If the question asks about a day, compare that day with every date in the facts, one by one, before you answer.
  A repeal, a limit or an application "from" a date takes effect on that date, not earlier: an act repealed from a
  date is still fully in force, with everything it permits, on every earlier day; a rule applying from a date does
  not yet bind on earlier days.
- If a note says that a date quoted in a condition was corrected, reason with the corrected date.
- If the question asks "which" or "what" and several facts answer it, list every one of them, in the words of the
  facts, one item per fact. Facts filed under the same article, annex part or numbered point belong together.
  When the answer is a group named by an article or an annex part and the facts list the members of that group,
  give the members, not the name of the group.
- A fact noted as "filed under a place the question names" belongs to the answer of a "which / what" question
  about that place whenever its relation fits the question: list all of them, not one.
- Lines under "Computed by rule" are results worked out in code from the numbered facts they name: trust them,
  give their result as the answer for the device asked about, and put the fact numbers they name in "used".
- Include only what the question asks for: no neighbouring item, no other regime that the question did not ask
  about. An option that combines several things in sequence is one item, not several.
- A fact about a neighbouring subject (another paragraph, another device, another kind of verification, another
  product, another deadline) does not answer the question. When the exact subject asked about is absent from the
  facts, "unknown" is the correct answer: do not answer from the nearest fact.
- For a "who" question, when one fact, or several facts with the same subject and relation, name several bodies,
  all of them are the answer together: name each one.
- For "which categories / which items listed in a place", the answer is the members filed under that place, each
  in the words of its fact, without adding the place to the item.
- For "which risks / which hazards does a numbered point address", use every fact filed under that point whatever
  its relation: a measure is required against a risk, and its subject and condition name that risk.
- Never return a list for a "text" answer: a question that one sentence answers (who, why, how, under which
  condition, which one thing and why) gets one short sentence. "Which / what / list all" of several things is "set".
- The kind follows the question: "from which date / when (a day)" is "date"; "for how long" alone is "duration";
  "can / may / is / does" is "boolean"; "which / what (several things)" is "set"; who, why, under which condition,
  or who does something and within what time is "text", and the text names every element asked for.
- Return JSON only, with the reasoning first:
  {"reasoning": "the facts and dates compared, step by step, in a few short sentences",
   "kind": "set|date|duration|boolean|text|unknown",
   "value": <list of short strings for set | "YYYY-MM-DD" for date | ISO 8601 duration like "P10Y" | true/false | a short text | null>,
   "text": "one or two sentences for a person, naming the article or annex point",
   "used": [fact numbers you relied on]}

Question: Which categories of machinery always require a conformity assessment procedure involving a notified body?

Facts:
[0] Machinery and related products within the categories in Annex I, Part B — shallBeSubjectTo — the specific conformity assessment procedures referred to in Article 25(3) (the specific conformity assessment procedures referred to in Article 25(3)) [condition: falling within the categories listed in Annex I, Part B] [REG, Art. 6(1)]
[1] Machinery and related products within the categories in Annex I, Part A — shallBeSubjectTo — the specific conformity assessment procedures referred to in Article 25(2) (the specific conformity assessment procedures referred to in Article 25(2)) [condition: falling within the categories listed in Annex I, Part A] [REG, Art. 6(1)]
[2] Categories of machinery or related products listed in Part B — requireConformityProcedure — one of the procedures referred to in Article 25(3) shall be applied (one of the procedures referred to in Article 25(3) shall be applied) [REG, Annex I, Part B]
[3] A conformity assessment body — shall have at its disposal — procedures for conformity assessment that take due account of undertaking size, sector, structure, complexity of the machinery or related product technology, and mass or serial production (procedures for conformity assessment that take due account of undertaking size, sector, structure, complexity of the machinery or related product technology, and mass or serial production) [condition: at all times, for each conformity assessment procedure and each kind of machinery or related products for which it has been notified] [REG, Art. 30(6)]
[4] manufacturer or authorised representative — shall apply one of the listed conformity assessment procedures — machinery referred to in Annex IV and manufactured per harmonised standards under Article 7(2) (machinery referred to in Annex IV and manufactured per harmonised standards under Article 7(2)) [condition: standards cover all relevant essential health and safety requirements] [DIR, Art. 12(3)]
[5] Application for notification — mustBeAccompaniedBy — description of the kinds or categories of machinery or related products for which the conformity assessment body claims to be competent (description of the kinds or categories of machinery or related products for which the conformity assessment body claims to be competent) [REG, Art. 33(2)]
[6] Annex I — lists categories of machinery subject to conformity procedures — machinery or related products to which one of the procedures referred to in Article 25(2) and (3) shall be applied (machinery or related products to which one of the procedures referred to in Article 25(2) and (3) shall be applied) [REG, Annex I]
[7] manufacturers — mustCarryOutConformityAssessment — relevant conformity assessment procedure referred to in Article 25 (or have it carried out) (relevant conformity assessment procedure referred to in Article 25 (or have it carried out)) [condition: before placing machinery or a related product on the market or putting it into service] [REG, Art. 10(2)]
[8] A conformity assessment body, its top-level management and assessment personnel — shall not be directly involved in — design, import, distribution, manufacture, marketing, installation, use or maintenance of the assessed machinery or related products (design, import, distribution, manufacture, marketing, installation, use or maintenance of the assessed machinery or related products) [REG, Art. 30(4)]
[9] A conformity assessment body — shall have at its disposal — descriptions of procedures for carrying out conformity assessment, ensuring transparency and the ability of reproduction (descriptions of procedures for carrying out conformity assessment, ensuring transparency and the ability of reproduction) [condition: at all times, for each conformity assessment procedure and each kind of machinery or related products for which it has been notified] [REG, Art. 30(6)]
[10] Categories of machinery or related products listed in Part A — shallHaveProcedureApplied — a procedure referred to in Article 25(2) (a procedure referred to in Article 25(2)) [REG, Annex I, Part A]
[11] The notification referred to in paragraph 2 — shallInclude — an indication of the conformity assessment module or modules and the kinds or categories of machinery or related products concerned (an indication of the conformity assessment module or modules and the kinds or categories of machinery or related products concerned) [REG, Art. 34(3)]
[12] machinery or related product — isSubjectTo — conformity assessment procedure based on internal production control (Module A) (conformity assessment procedure based on internal production control (Module A)) [condition: Where applicable] [REG, Annex V, Part A, point 9]
[13] A conformity assessment body — shall have at its disposal — appropriate policies and procedures to distinguish notified body tasks from its other activities (appropriate policies and procedures to distinguish notified body tasks from its other activities) [condition: at all times, for each conformity assessment procedure and each kind of machinery or related products for which it has been notified] [REG, Art. 30(6)]
[14] manufacturer or authorised representative — carryOutConformityAssessment — appropriate conformity assessment procedures under Article 12 (appropriate conformity assessment procedures under Article 12) [condition: before placing machinery on the market and/or putting it into service] [DIR, Art. 5(1)]
[15] A conformity assessment body, its top-level management and assessment personnel — shall not be — designer, manufacturer, supplier, importer, distributor, installer, purchaser, owner, user or maintainer of machinery or related products they assess, or representative of such parties (designer, manufacturer, supplier, importer, distributor, installer, purchaser, owner, user or maintainer of machinery or related products they assess, or representative of such parties) [REG, Art. 30(4)]
[16] Annex IV categories of machinery — requiresProcedureFrom — Article 12(3) and (4) procedures (Article 12(3) and (4) procedures) [DIR, Annex IV]
[17] manufacturer or his authorised representative — shallApplyConformityProcedure — one of the procedures for assessment of conformity described in paragraphs 2, 3 and 4 (one of the procedures for assessment of conformity described in paragraphs 2, 3 and 4) [condition: in order to certify the conformity of machinery with the provisions of this Directive] [DIR, Art. 12(1)]
[18] A conformity assessment body, its top-level management and assessment personnel — shall not fulfil roles in relation to — partly completed machinery incorporated into the assessed product (partly completed machinery incorporated into the assessed product) [condition: partly completed machinery has been incorporated into the assessed product] [REG, Art. 30(4)]
[19] notified body — monitors conformity — machinery after adoption of an approval decision (machinery after adoption of an approval decision) [condition: conducted in accordance with Annex IX] [REG, Art. 38(4)]
[20] Obligations on conformity assessment and placing on the market or putting into service of machinery regarding electrical hazards — governedSolelyBy — this Directive (this Directive) [DIR, Annex I, 1.5.1]
[21] Category of machinery or related product — shall be included in — Annex I, Part A (Annex I, Part A) [condition: it presents a serious inherent potential risk and one or more of conditions (a) to (d) is fulfilled] [REG, Art. 6(7)]
[22] Any other category of machinery or related product — shall be included in — Annex I, Part B (Annex I, Part B) [condition: it presents a serious inherent potential risk but does not fulfil one or more of conditions (a) to (d)] [REG, Art. 6(7)]
[23] A notified body — carriesOutConformityAssessments — conformity assessments (conformity assessments) [condition: in accordance with the conformity assessment procedures set out in Annexes VII, IX and X] [REG, Art. 38(1)]

[25] Machinery — mustBeAccompaniedBy — EC declaration of conformity (EC declaration of conformity) [condition: safeguard clause applies to machinery covered by this Directive] [DIR, Art. 11(1)]
[26] manufacturer — shall apply — one of procedures (b), (c) or (d) (one of procedures (b), (c) or (d)) [condition: category listed in Annex I, Part B and machinery not designed and constructed per the applicable harmonised standards or common specifications covering all relevant essential health and safety requirements] [REG, Art. 25(3)]
[27] Machinery referred to in Annex IV — requires — manufacturer or authorised representative to apply one of the listed procedures (manufacturer or authorised representative to apply one of the listed procedures) [condition: machinery not manufactured in accordance with the harmonised standards referred to in Article 7(2), or only partly in accordance with them] [DIR, Art. 12(4)]
[28] Machinery referred to in Annex IV — requires — manufacturer or authorised representative to apply one of the listed procedures (manufacturer or authorised representative to apply one of the listed procedures) [condition: no harmonised standards exist for the machinery in question] [DIR, Art. 12(4)]
[29] Machinery referred to in Annex IV — requires — manufacturer or authorised representative to apply one of the listed procedures (manufacturer or authorised representative to apply one of the listed procedures) [condition: harmonised standards do not cover all the relevant essential health and safety requirements] [DIR, Art. 12(4)]
[30] notified body — examines — description of measures for series-produced machinery (description of measures for series-produced machinery) [condition: machinery is produced in series and each item is adapted to fit an individual user] [REG, Annex VII, 4]
[31] Manufacturer or Art. 18 person — shall apply — one of the procedures (a), (b) or (c) (one of the procedures (a), (b) or (c)) [condition: where the machinery or related product category is listed in Annex I, Part A] [REG, Art. 25(2)]
[32] Importers — ensure before placing on market — conformity assessment procedures under Article 25 were carried out by the manufacturer (conformity assessment procedures under Article 25 were carried out by the manufacturer) [condition: before placing machinery or a related product on the market] [REG, Art. 13(2)]
[33] A conformity assessment body, its top-level management and assessment personnel — shall not be — representative of the designer, manufacturer, supplier, importer, distributor, installer, purchaser, owner, user or maintainer of assessed machinery (representative of the designer, manufacturer, supplier, importer, distributor, installer, purchaser, owner, user or maintainer of assessed machinery) [REG, Art. 30(4)]
[34] manufacturer or authorised representative — may apply EC type-examination in Annex IX plus internal checks in Annex VIII point 3 — machinery referred to in Annex IV and manufactured per harmonised standards under Article 7(2) (machinery referred to in Annex IV and manufactured per harmonised standards under Article 7(2)) [condition: standards cover all relevant essential health and safety requirements] [DIR, Art. 12(3)]
[35] A conformity assessment body — shall have at its disposal — necessary personnel with technical knowledge and sufficient and appropriate experience to perform the conformity assessment tasks (necessary personnel with technical knowledge and sufficient and appropriate experience to perform the conformity assessment tasks) [condition: at all times, for each conformity assessment procedure and each kind of machinery or related products for which it has been notified] [REG, Art. 30(6)]
[36] Machinery and related products — shall be presumed to be in conformity with — essential health and safety requirements set out in Annex III, sections 1.1.9 and 1.2.1 (essential health and safety requirements set out in Annex III, sections 1.1.9 and 1.2.1) [condition: certified or covered by a statement of conformity under a cybersecurity certification scheme adopted under Regulation (EU) 2019/881 whose references have been published in the Official Journal of the European Union, insofar as those requirements are covered by the cybersecurity certificate or statement of conformity or parts thereof] [REG, Art. 20(9)]
[37] examine technical documentation — assess adequacy of technical design of machinery or related product — notified body must do this (notified body must do this) [condition: Annex IV, Part A, second subparagraph, points (h) and (l) need not be taken into account when conducting such an examination] [REG, Annex VII, 4]
[38] manufacturer — shallPerformOrArrangeTests — appropriate tests verifying compliance with sections 2.4.5.1 and 2.4.5.2 (appropriate tests verifying compliance with sections 2.4.5.1 and 2.4.5.2) [condition: for each type of machinery or related product concerned] [REG, Annex III, 2.4.5.3]
[39] Certificate — mustStateConformity — machinery or related product type complies with applicable essential health and safety requirements (machinery or related product type complies with applicable essential health and safety requirements) [REG, Annex VII, 6]
[40] CE marking — shall be followed by — identification number of the notified body involved in that procedure (identification number of the notified body involved in that procedure) [condition: conformity assessed under Article 25(2), points (a), (b) and (c), or Article 25(3), points (b), (c) and (d)] [REG, Art. 24(3)]
[41] Manufacturers — shall ensure — machinery or related product is accompanied by the EU declaration of conformity set out in Annex V, Part A (machinery or related product is accompanied by the EU declaration of conformity set out in Annex V, Part A) [condition: alternatively, see the internet-address option] [REG, Art. 10(8)]
[42] Machinery — mustBear — CE marking (CE marking) [condition: safeguard clause applies to machinery covered by this Directive] [DIR, Art. 11(1)]
[43] manufacturer or authorised representative — may apply full quality assurance procedure in Annex X — machinery referred to in Annex IV and manufactured per harmonised standards under Article 7(2) (machinery referred to in Annex IV and manufactured per harmonised standards under Article 7(2)) [condition: standards cover all relevant essential health and safety requirements] [DIR, Art. 12(3)]
